"use client"

import {
  CommandMenu,
  CommandMenuFooter,
  CommandMenuItem,
  CommandMenuLabel,
  CommandMenuList,
  CommandMenuSearch,
  CommandMenuSection,
} from "@/registry/preskok/ui/preskok-ui/command-menu"

export default function CommandMenuPreskokDemo() {
  return (
    <CommandMenu isOpen aria-label="Command" shortcut="k">
      <CommandMenuSearch />
      <CommandMenuList>
        <CommandMenuSection title="General">
          <CommandMenuItem>Open</CommandMenuItem>
          <CommandMenuItem>Save</CommandMenuItem>
        </CommandMenuSection>
        <CommandMenuSection title="Navigation">
          <CommandMenuItem>
            <CommandMenuLabel>Go to Dashboard</CommandMenuLabel>
          </CommandMenuItem>
        </CommandMenuSection>
      </CommandMenuList>
      <CommandMenuFooter>Press ⌘K to open</CommandMenuFooter>
    </CommandMenu>
  )
}
